newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Gulf basis firms slightly.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Gulf basis firms slightly.

text.p: Basis bids for hard red winter wheat at the Gulf of Mexico were slightly firmer Friday, but grain merchandisers in the High Plains said farmer sales of wheat remained flat.
"The focus is on fall feedgrains, so there's no wheat moving," said a dealer in south central Kansas.
Wheat in Houston was being bid at 54 cents over the KCBT December contract -- a one cent increase from Thursday's bid.
Meanwhile, dealers said temperatures had cooled down substantially overnight, and they added that weather conditions looked set to remain clear during the weekend.
"We missed the rain last night. Looks like we'll have another big harvest weekend on our hands," said a dealer in northeast Oklahoma.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
(Note: Z=KCBT December wheat futures. unq- unquoted, na - not applicable)
